commits.author: StanGirard
commits.subject: fix(push): improve iOS PWA notification deep linking
commits.body:
- Update sw.js notification click handler with iOS fallback
- Store deeplink URL in cache for app to retrieve on load
- Add postMessage support for NOTIFICATION_CLICK events
- Create useNotificationDeeplink hook to handle SW messages
- Remove sw.js from gitignore to version manual updates

iOS PWA has issues with clients.navigate(). This fix uses a
cache-based fallback where the URL is stored and the app
retrieves it on load.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

commits.subject: feat(session): add clone repo tab and terminal at root option
commits.body:
Add two new features to the New Session modal:
- Clone tab: allows cloning a Git repo (HTTPS/SSH) before starting session
- Terminal at root: option to start terminal at basePath instead of a project

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
